## Purpose
Card that shows a work-experience timeline (period, position, company) on the portfolio page. It takes sanitized experience entries plus a `loading` flag and renders skeleton placeholders while loading.

## Key concepts
- `ExperienceCard({experiences, loading})` renders an `<ol>` timeline of `ListItem`s.
- `SanitizedExperience` comes from [[src-interfaces]]; `skeleton()` from [[src-utils]].
- Time label is built as `${from} - ${to}`.

## Gotchas
- `ListItem` always renders an `<a>` for the company, even when `companyLink` is undefined (the anchor then has no href).
